WITH spec AS (
  INSERT INTO acceptance_specs
    (job_id, version, test_command, build_command, failing_tests, allowed_paths, test_files)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::int, $3, $4,
        ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($5::jsonb)),
        ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($6::jsonb)), $7::jsonb)
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO spec_checks (spec_id, position, name, how_verified, weight)
SELECT spec.id, (c.ord - 1)::smallint, c.v->>'name', c.v->>'howVerified',
       coalesce(c.v->>'weight', 'required')::check_weight
FROM spec, jsonb_array_elements($8::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS c(v, ord)
RETURNING spec_id;
